t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Bullied Out of School
d: Aabrea and Jerae bullied a high school girl so badly that she dropped out. Can Steve help them resolve their differences and figure out why so many teens turn to bullying?

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did The Babysitter Abuse My Child?
st: Did The Babysitter Abuse My Child?
d: Stephanie says that ever since she came home from work to find her 1-year-old with a black eye, she has feared that her children's babysitter harms them. Sitter Cheryl denies some serious accusations about a child.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man
st: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This
st: I'm a Survivor, but I Can't Take This

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: How Could You Cover for Him?
st: How Could You Cover for Him?
d: Gina believes that her daughter’s boyfriend Efrain is abusing her grandson. Her daughter wants to prove that Efrain is innocent, but her father Raul suspects she is covering for Efrain.

d: Anita is ready to dump her husband for her ex-lover. Next, Theresa is cheating on her fiancé with his brother! Later, Kevin is here to tell his girlfriend's ex, Jermaine, to back off.

d: Carla has been cheating on her man with his best friend and his sister! Next, Yvonne will tell her friend Marie that she's been sleeping with her boyfriend. Mary Sue and her secret lover, Cory, are here to confront Mary Sue's boyfriend, Scott.

t: The Jerry Springer Show: I'll Fight For My Man
d: Rochelle will confront her ex Nathan and the other woman and Liz will stop at nothing to ruin her man's relationship with another woman, who's pregnant with his baby!

d: Dan is here today to beg Heather to give him another chance. Next, Ginny wants Tim back and says that he still calls her. Later, Shenidia is furious that another women is trying to steal her boyfriend of 4 years, Gary.

d: Linda says her former best friend is trying to steal her man and she's fighting back! Then, Sherry wants her boyfriend Terry's wife Sandy and her family out of their lives!

d: Done with her abusive relationship, Carla tells her boyfriend that she is cheating on him with his roommate. Then, Jay wants to tell Nikki she slept with her lover Crystal.

t: The Jerry Springer Show: I Want To Be Dominated
d: Johnny wants his girlfriend Aimee to accept him for who he is. Then, Maya comes on the show to confront her boyfriend Eric about his tendencies.

t: The Jerry Springer Show: Ex-Lovers Confronted
d: Today on Jerry Springer, did Chris and Shawn move to escape his ex Joy or to hide his extracurriculars with her? Next Jerome explains why his wife causes him to cheat!

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Boyfriend Beat Up My Mom
st: My Boyfriend Beat Up My Mom
d: Kendra is on a mission to save herself from her toxic boyfriend Chris. At 17, Kendra is pregnant with his sixth child. Kendra has tried almost everything including kicking him out of their house, but he not only argued back but assaulted Kendra as well.

d: Korey is positive that his girlfriend Dominique is cheating on him and is also worried that she might be selling sex. She says that his suspicions have caused him to become abusive. Then, Gregory thinks that his girlfriend Robin isn’t faithful!

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Did It To Hurt You
st: I Did It To Hurt You
d: Aeshia’s here to prove to Terrence and his wife Lashondra that Terrence is the father of her child, but Lashondra knows she’s wrong! Both Shaunah and Chris have convinced themselves that they’re being cheated on. Who’s the father?

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Slept Around: Who's the Dad?
st: I Slept Around: Who's the Dad?

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Do You Need a Medic or Are You Guilty?
st: Do You Need a Medic or Are You Guilty?
d: Michelle needs answers about who hurt her daughter. She will stop at nothing to protect her baby. Will the father James clear his name on Steve's stage?

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Rescues a Runaway
d: Sherry was attacked at 15 and ran away from home. She wants Steve’s help with reuniting her with her mother. Then, Dawn's teenage daughter Cathy recently gave birth, but lives in fear of the baby’s unemployed and unstable father Nick.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, I Think He's Gay
d: Monique’s friend claims that Adrian advertised himself on a “Gay for Pay” website. Then, pregnant Tyeasha suspects David of cheating on her with men. What will the polygraph say?
